test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Someity is related to which of the following events?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tokyo paralympic 2020 **__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is Tokyo Paralympic 2020.**
 
• **Someity is the official mascot of the Tokyo Paralympics 2020.**
 
• ** It is a futuristic creature inspired by the** **Japanese folklore of "Koma Inu" or guardian lions**.
 
• ** Someity represents the** **Paralympic athletes who overcome obstacles and strive for excellence.**
 
• The name is Someity is a combination of the English words "so mighty" and "somebody".
 
• Option 4 is correct as Someity is related to the Tokyo Paralympics 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tokyo Olympics 2020 also had an official mascot named Miraitowa, which represents the future and innovation. 
 
• Winter Olympics 2022 will be held in Beijing, China and its official mascot is Bing Dwen Dwen, a panda wearing a suit of ice.
 
• Commonwealth Games 2022 will be held in Birmingham, England and its official mascot has not been announced yet.
